title: unify-sdks-auth-retries-streaming-parity-and-version-bump-v1.166.0
author: Priya Rao
release_notes: SDKs: unify auth+retries behavior across Python/TS/Go; streaming API ergonomics fixes; parity fixes and version bump to v1.166.0. See changelog for migration notes.
body:
Context and motivation:
Unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across SDKs to reduce producer/consumer surface differences and avoid subtle behavioral drift that caused observed retry loops and inconsistent streaming backpressure in client apps. This changelist aligns Python/TypeScript/Go behavior with the runtime expectations and ships a non-breaking version bump to v1.166.0.

Summary of changes (single continuous description):
- Standardize auth header refresh behavior: all SDKs now treat 401 from the transport as a signal to attempt a single refresh + replay for idempotent requests and abort for non-idempotent ones.
- Centralize retry policy: introduced a shared retry contract (max_retries, backoff_jitter, retry_on id list) implemented across SDKs with language-idiomatic wrappers.
- Streaming ergonomics: improved client-side streaming API to expose a unified iterator/pull interface (Python generator, TS AsyncIterable, Go channel) and fixed KV-cache related stall when reconnecting mid-stream.
- Parity fixes: aligned default timeouts, header propagation, and error shapes returned by the SDKs.
- Tests & release: integration tests added for auth refresh and stream reconnect; bumped package versions (python v1.166.0, typescript v1.166.0, go v1.166.0).

Commits (high level):
- 3 commits by Priya Rao: initial unification work (auth/retries), streaming refactor, tests and version bumps.
- 2 follow-ups by Alex Kim: TS typing fixes and CI adjustments.
- 1 commit by Daniel Ortega: Go retry wrapper and test harness.

Files changed (high level):
- sdks/*: new retry contract and auth refresh hooks added; streaming API refactor across languages.
- docs/: add SDK migration notes and streaming ergonomics doc.
- integration-tests/: new end-to-end tests covering auth refresh and stream reconnect.
- ci/: workflow updated to run cross-language integration matrix.

Review conversation (selected highlights):
- Alex Kim (review): "TS typings LGTM but streaming iterator should expose cancel() ergonomics; otherwise good. Please add a short example to docs."
- Priya Rao (author): "Added cancel() to the TS AsyncIterable wrapper and example in docs; kept Python/Go idiomatic cancel semantics (generator.close/context cancel)."
- Maya Singh (review): "Can we avoid automatic retry for non-idempotent endpoints by default? Suggest exposing opt-in per-call override."
- Priya Rao: "Agree; added opt-in flag `allow_replay_on_auth` with default false for non-idempotent methods and documented behavior in sdk-retries.md."
- Daniel Ortega: "Go linter flagged an unused var in retries.go after my initial commit; pushed fix and updated tests."
- Alex Kim (approval): "Approved pending green CI."

CI summary:
- Initial run: lint failures in TS (typo in example) and flaky integration test for streaming reconnect.
- Fixes applied: corrected example in TS, added a small sleep+retry in test harness to stabilize reconnect test.
- Final run: all checks passed (unit, lint, cross-lang integration matrix).

Merge outcome:
- Merged via squash on 2026-02-18 by Priya Rao after approvals from Alex Kim and Maya Singh and green CI.
- Release: packaged and published artifacts for Python/TS/Go with version v1.166.0; CHANGELOG updated.

Notes for release engineers:
- Python: ensure wheels are uploaded to the internal index; migration note added to docs/sdk-auth.md.
- TS: published to internal npm mirror; update downstream examples that relied on previous streaming pull semantics.
- Go: module proxy updated and go.sum verified.

Related tickets: ENG-2134 (SDK parity initiative), ENG-2211 (streaming reliability).
